title: Metrology Maven derived toleranced element (fid.derived-element/1)
description: A derived element returned by derive() (spec node GDT.LOC.DERIV.TYPES): an axis, a derived median line, a median surface or median points, with the algorithm ID of the reduction operator that produced it and the flags its implementation passed through. Every float is bit exact: "0x" plus 16 lowercase hex digits of the IEEE 754 binary64 bits, finite only. Coordinates are in metres in the frame of the input points. The fid-gps constructors are stricter: an axis direction and every normal is a unit vector within 1e-12 on its squared norm, and an axis extent is not negative.

flags.description: local_optimum_only: the element rests on a fit certified only as a local optimum (or not certified), so it is never a datum or a value of record without a global cross-check. An absent local_optimum_only is the implementation's claim (closed form, or a fit's global certificate), not a global certificate checked by derive().

f64.description: A finite binary64 as 0x plus 16 lowercase hex digits; the first three digits (sign and exponent) are never 7ff or fff.
